transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's nice to meet you too. Thank you for seeing me. Um... I guess mostly I'm here because I've just been feeling a little tired lately? It's probably nothing major, I mean, everyone gets tired, right? But it's just... it's a sort of tired that sleeping doesn't really seem to fix. Like, even doing little things, like unloading the dishwasher or trying to read for this certificate class I'm taking... it just feels like a bit too much sometimes. I hope that makes sense? I know it sounds silly to complain about just being tired.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Oh, um... no, I wouldn't say depressed. I mean, I really hope I don't come across that way! I try to stay pretty positive most of the time. It's honestly just... the lack of energy, I think? Like, I don't feel sad or hopeless or anything like that. Just... drained. 

I hope that makes sense? I wouldn't want you to think I'm just sitting around crying all day or anything, because I'm definitely not. I'm just a bit worn out, is all. Is it normal to just be tired without being depressed?
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Um, no, I don't think so. I try to make sure I get a good amount of sleep every night, like you're supposed to. I'm definitely not up all night tossing and turning or anything like that! I usually get my normal hours in... I think? 

It's really just that even after I sleep, I still wake up feeling pretty drained. But the actual sleeping part seems completely fine, as far as I know. Is... is that what you meant?
Have you been feeling unusually worried or anxious lately?

Oh, um, no, I don't think so. I try really hard not to be a worrier, you know? I know stress isn't good for you, so I just try to take things as they come. 

I mean, everyone gets a little stressed sometimes, right? But I definitely wouldn't say I've been unusually anxious or anything like that. I try to keep a pretty level head. I hope that's okay? I just wouldn't want you to think I'm overreacting to things or making a big deal out of nothing. But no, no unusual anxiety, I don't think.
Have you noticed any recent weight gain?

Oh, um, weight gain? No, actually, I haven't gained any weight. I try to take good care of myself, you know? 

If anything, um... I might have actually lost a little bit? Not on purpose, I promise! I definitely haven't been doing any crazy diets or anything like that. It's just... my appetite has been a little off lately, I guess. Sometimes I'll get to the end of the day and realize I've really only had coffee and maybe a few bites of something. 

My jeans have actually gotten a little looser, which I didn't even mean to happen. I hope that's alright? I know you're supposed to eat three square meals a day, and I'm really trying to be better about it, I swear. I just haven't been super hungry. Is that... is that something I should be worried about?
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Oh, um... well, I try really hard to stay active and keep busy, you know? I know it's important to have hobbies. 

But I guess... maybe lately I haven't been doing as much of the stuff I normally like? Like, I usually love sketching and going to gallery openings, or cooking nice meals, doing yoga, even playing tennis with my friend. I know I should be keeping up with all that, and I really am trying to push myself to do them. It's just... lately it feels like I've kind of stopped caring about them as much? 

They just don't make me feel like myself right now. But I'm sure it's just a phase, right? I don't want you to think I'm just sitting around doing nothing all day. I'm definitely going to try harder to get back into my routine. Is it normal to just need a break from your hobbies sometimes?
Have you been feeling sad or low much of the time?

Oh, um, no. Not really. I try my best to keep a positive attitude, you know? I really don't want to be... well, I don't want to be a downer or complain. 

I know everyone gets a little blue sometimes, but I definitely wouldn't say I've been feeling sad or low much of the time. I try to just look on the bright side and keep smiling. I hope that's the right way to handle things? I just really want to make sure I'm doing my best to stay upbeat so I'm not bringing anyone else down.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Oh, um, concentrating? I mean, I wouldn't say I'm having *trouble*, exactly. I know how important it is to stay organized, especially when you're taking classes and managing a household. I really try to stay on top of things.

But I guess... maybe I've been a little bit scattered lately? Just a tiny bit. Like, I'll sit with my planning app open on my phone, and I just... I can't quite decide what to tackle first. Like, whether I should work on a class assignment, or pay a bill, or start getting dinner ready. And then I end up just kind of staring at the screen and not doing any of it for a little while. 

I'm really trying to get better at prioritizing, I promise. I know I should just pick something and do it. It's just been a little harder to focus my thoughts, I suppose? I hope that doesn't sound too bad. I'm definitely going to try using a new scheduling method to fix it, do you think that's a good idea?
Have these changes in your energy, appetite, interest, and concentration been going on for at least two weeks?

Oh, um... yeah, it's... it's definitely been at least two weeks. I really want to be completely honest with you, even though I'm a little embarrassed to admit it. 

I guess this... this quieter stretch, you know, with the low interest and just feeling that heavy fatigue? It's actually been going on for about three months now. I really hope you don't think I've just been letting myself go or not trying to get better for that whole time. I promise I've been fighting it every single day and doing my absolute best to keep my energy up. 

I know I should have probably shaken it off by now. Is it okay that it's taking me a little longer to bounce back? I really am trying my hardest.
Did anything particularly stressful or upsetting happen around the time this started?

Oh, um, no, not really. I mean, I've been trying to think back, but nothing stands out as a big crisis or anything like that. I really wish I had a better reason for feeling this way, you know? It feels a little silly to be struggling when everything is basically fine. 

I know some people go through really terrible things, and I don't have anything like that to point to. I hope it doesn't seem like I'm making a big deal out of nothing? I really try to handle whatever comes my way without letting it get to me. So, no, nothing particularly upsetting happened. I hope that's an okay answer?
Before this started three months ago, have you ever had another period in your life lasting at least two weeks when you felt similarly drained and lost interest in things?

Oh, um... no, I don't think so. I really don't think I've ever felt quite this... stuck before. 

I mean, everyone gets a little tired or sad sometimes, right? Like if they catch a cold or just have a long week. I've definitely had days where I just wanted to stay in bed, but I've always managed to push through it and get back to normal pretty quickly. I've always prided myself on being pretty resilient. 

So, no, I've never had a stretch like this that lasted two whole weeks. I really hope that means it's just a temporary thing and I'll be back to my old self soon? I'm definitely going to keep trying my best to snap out of it, I promise.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Oh, um... no. No, definitely not. I mean, I know I've been in a bit of a slump lately, but I haven't had any thoughts like that. 

I would never want to do anything to hurt myself, or... or upset the people around me, you know? I really try to find the good in things, even when it's a little hard to get out of bed. I hope you don't think I'm completely giving up? I promise I still care about my life and getting better. I'm really trying my best to stay as positive as I can. 

Is that... I mean, it's a good thing that I'm not having those kinds of thoughts, right? I really want to make sure I'm handling this the right way.
Have you felt like your body or your movements have been slowed down lately?

Oh, um... well, maybe just a little bit? I mean, I really try not to let it show, but... on my slower days, it kind of feels like my body is moving through wet cement. 

It's a little embarrassing to admit, honestly. Like, sometimes my husband will ask me a really simple question, and... and it just takes me a weirdly long time to answer him. I feel so bad about it, because I don't want him to think I'm ignoring him or being difficult. I'm really trying to stay on top of things and keep up, I promise. 

I hope it doesn't make me sound lazy or anything? I'm doing my best to push through that heavy feeling. Is it normal to feel a little sluggish like that when you're going through a slump?
